title: Do you struggle to sleep with racing thoughts at night?
body_text:
He that keepeth thee will not slumber. Behold, He that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep (Psalm 121:3-4).

You can rest peacefully tonight because God never sleeps. He is watching over your home right now. How can we pray for your rest tonight?

poll.question: What helps you find the deepest peace before bedtime?
